d: Long, flowing jet black hair with straight-cut bangs and a center part frames the face of a youthful, teenage adolescent with a slender build. The eyes are large, expressive, and colored a warm golden-brown. Wearing a short-sleeved olive green dress with a brown vertical stripe down the center, a white undershirt, and a black belt with a silver buckle, the figure is equipped with heavy grey metallic naval artillery rigging and turrets attached to the shoulders and sides.
